title: Professional Cannabis Cultivation Education
intro: Build practical cultivation knowledge through plant science, applied practice, field references, and progressive training pathways. Start with Technician I, advance through Technician II, then explore specialist and leadership programs.

statusDefinitions.available-academic: Public course content is available for study. This does not mean the related professional certification is available for issuance.
statusDefinitions.in-development: The pathway has active curriculum and assessment development but is not approved for credential issuance.
statusDefinitions.planned: The pathway is part of the canonical credential architecture and awaits full production build-out.

credentialSections.title: Foundational Certificates
credentialSections.description: Prerequisite learning certificates that prepare learners for professional credential pathways.

offerings.title: THC Safety & Responsible Practice Certificate
offerings.summary: Foundational safety, responsible practice, sanitation, controlled workflow, documentation, and escalation knowledge for learners entering professional cultivation training.

offerings.title: THC Cultivation Foundations Certificate
offerings.summary: Foundational cultivation science and workflow knowledge intended to prepare learners for professional technician pathways.

credentialSections.title: Technician Pathway
credentialSections.description: Progressive applied cultivation credentials for entry and advanced cultivation technicians.

offerings.title: THC Cultivation Technician I
offerings.summary: Seven-course Technician I academic pathway is publicly available. The separate professional certification remains in development and credential issuance is blocked pending occupational validation, secure assessment, practical/capstone validation, standard setting, governance, accessibility, and production authorization.

availableCourse.label: All 7 Technician I academic courses available

offerings.title: THC Cultivation Technician II
offerings.summary: Eight-course Technician II academic pathway is publicly available. The separate professional certification remains in development and credential issuance is blocked pending occupational validation, secure assessment, practical/capstone validation, standard setting, governance, accessibility, and production authorization.

availableCourse.label: All 8 Technician II academic courses available

credentialSections.title: Specialist Certifications
credentialSections.description: Role-focused specialist credentials for advanced cultivation practice.

offerings.title: THC Plant Health, IPM & Biosecurity Specialist
offerings.summary: Scouting, differential diagnosis, pest biology, disease and HLVd, IPM, biological and cultural controls, outbreak containment, corrective action, and diagnostic case work.

offerings.title: THC Environmental, Irrigation & Fertigation Systems Specialist
offerings.summary: Lighting, HVAC and dehumidification, airflow, sensors and controls, water quality, irrigation, root-zone management, crop steering, automation, and reliability.

offerings.title: THC Propagation & Clean Stock Specialist
offerings.summary: Seed biology, donor management, cloning, rooting and acclimation, sanitation, biosecurity, traceability, clean stock, tissue-culture fundamentals, and troubleshooting.

offerings.title: THC Postharvest Quality Specialist
offerings.summary: Harvest readiness, sanitary handling, drying, water activity, curing, storage, packaging, defects, laboratory and COA literacy, traceability, QA, recall, and disposition concepts.

offerings.title: THC Genetics, Breeding & Preservation Specialist
offerings.summary: Inheritance, quantitative traits, genotype-by-environment, phenotyping, population design, backcrossing, selfing, line breeding, progeny testing, seed production, and genetic preservation.

credentialSections.title: Advanced Professional
credentialSections.description: Operations-level cultivation leadership integrating the earlier technician and specialist domains.

offerings.title: THC Cultivation Lead & Operations Professional
offerings.summary: Production planning, workforce coordination, crop-system oversight, metrics and economics, SOP and document control, quality systems, CAPA, equipment reliability, audit readiness, and continuous improvement.
